The goal is to support Kenya's Urban Sector through strengthened partnership between Sweden and World Bank.Objectives are: foster environment for effective urban development; enahnce cooperation between Sweden and World Bank in the urban sector.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2016Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The rationale of this Project has been to strengthen collaboration and promote more strategic use of Resources by the World Bank and Sweden in implementing the "joint urban program". Sweden supports KMP, KISIP and NaMSIP which are all World Bank program within urban development sector. The Project has supported mainstreaming of Human rights, a general Review or urbanisation in Kenyan and various analyses, especially regarding devolution and urban service delivery. Another important aspect has been to support and improve coordination between different actors within the urban sector, such as UN-habitat and CSUDP.
